description:
According to Revelation 19:10, what exactly is the spirit of prophecy? John Dinzey will provide a biblical answer to this question and many more. Shelley Quinn and Daniel Perrin also answer some in-depth questions from viewers like you. Hosted by Ricky Carter. Don't forget to submit your questions!

Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1.  According to Revelation 19:10, what exactly is the spirit of prophecy? 

2.  If I was baptized, as a Baptist, do I have to be rebaptized now that I am a Seventh-day Adventist? Do I need to be rebaptized as a Seventh-day Adventist? 
 
3.   What is Sheol, and what is Abaddon? Are these figures of speech from Bible times? To me, it seems that those in the Old Testament see Sheol as a literal place. For example, Proverbs 15: 24. 
 
4.  2 Corinthians 12 mentions that Paul was caught up to the third heaven. Where is that and what does it mean? Where is the Third Heaven? 
 
5.  Moses fasted for 40 days the first time God give him the 10 commandments. After he broke the first set, did Moses go back up immediately to the mountain to receive the second set? Did he fast again? How many times did Moses fast on Mount Sinai? 
 
6.  I have grown up in the Seventh-Day Adventist Church and believed that we followed Sola Scriptura. However, since we quote Sister White as authoritative but not above the Bible, shouldn’t our position be Prima Scriptura with the Bible being our primary source of authority on all spiritual and moral matters? Does the Seventh-Day Adventist Church abide by Sola Scriptura or Prima Scriptura?  
 
7.  What is the City of David? Is it Jerusalem or Bethlehem?  
 
8.  Did Satan inherit expansion of life span as a fallen angel when he got cast out of heaven? How is it that he cannot die until the appointed time of Christ's return in comparison to us human beings? How is it that humans die but Satan remains until an appointed time? Did Satan inherit expansion of life span when he got cast out of Heaven? 
 
9.  Can you please explain Isaiah 65:20? 
 
10.  During Bible study with my family the statement was made that wickedness came from the sons of God/Angels intermarrying with humans. Referring to the scripture Genesis 6:2. I went to Matthew 22:30 to explain that angels do not marry. Are there other scriptures to answer this question? Did angels intermarry with humans? 
 
11.  Can you explain Hebrews 10:26? Does it mean even if we repent and are sincere and turn away from that sin that it will not be forgiven? 
 
12.   Can you please explain Leviticus 8:23?
